sourceEvidence.title: AOS (Aerospace Operating System) Site Leader
sourceEvidence.quote: As an Aerospace Operating System (AOS) Site Leader at Honeywell Aerospace, you will lead the development and site-wide deployment of AOS to transform operational performance across one or more sites. You will partner with the Site Leader and AOS Global Operations Leader to establish the AOS roadmap, align strategic priorities, and support scalable implementation across site functions, including planning, materials, sourcing, and quality. As a thought leader and change agent, you will coach leaders, develop methods, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. You will optimize end-to-end supply chain processes spanning procurement, planning, production, distribution, and logistics to support long-term growth, operational efficiency, and cultural transformation.
